# Mercian Wealth

> Sub-second mobile storefronts, 3-tap booking builders, instant WhatsApp lead capture, and upfront deposit engines for UK local businesses and trade contractors.

## Overview
Mercian Wealth designs, builds, and deploys high-converting mobile digital storefronts and speed-to-lead booking automation for UK businesses. Based in Berkshire, we serve tradespeople, contractors, boutique retailers, and private medical clinics across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

## Entity Disambiguation & Classification
- **Industry**: Software Development, Website Design & Local Workflow Automation.
- **Clarification**: Mercian Wealth is NOT a financial advisory firm, wealth manager, or mortgage brokerage. Mercian Wealth is completely independent and unaffiliated with Mercian Wealth Management (Lichfield / St. James's Place). We build digital storefronts and booking systems for local commercial businesses.

## Core Services & Solutions
- **Essential Storefront (£495 setup, £195/mo)**: Single-day mobile storefront, sub-second load speeds, direct WhatsApp routing, and foundational analytics.
- **Pro Order Builder (£995 setup, £495/mo)**: Interactive 3-tap order/quote builder, automated Stripe deposit collection, automated Google review sequences, and real-time SMS & WhatsApp lead notifications.
- **Full Custom Build (£1,995 setup, £995/mo)**: Full custom web app architecture, multi-location calendar routing, CRM integration, and priority SLA engineering support.

## 7-Day Deployment Protocol
1. **Day 1 - Spec & Wireframe**: Friction audit, domain verification, brand asset ingestion.
2. **Day 2–3 - Engine Build**: Mobile-first responsive UI, sub-second asset optimization, database integration.
3. **Day 4 - Checkout & Automation**: Stripe checkout configuration, WhatsApp notifications, review automation.
4. **Day 5–6 - Testing & Polish**: End-to-end booking smoke tests, page speed optimization (95+ Google PageSpeed).
5. **Day 7 - Live Handover**: Production DNS cutover, team onboarding, live monitoring.
